services.name: Comprehensive Cost Estimating
services.description: Full-scope construction estimating including material quantities, labor rates, equipment pricing, general conditions, and subcontractor scopes.

services.name: Trade-Specific Quantity Takeoffs
services.description: Precise measurement counts for trade subcontractors: Drywall, Framing, Roofing, Painting, Concrete, Masonry, MEP, and Flooring.
deliverables: Itemized Bill of Materials with scrap/waste allowances

services.name: MEP Estimating (Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing)
services.description: Specialized MEP estimating covering HVAC equipment, ductwork, piping, electrical fixtures, switchgear, panels, conduit, wire, plumbing fixtures, and fire protection.
deliverables: Detailed fixture and equipment count schedules
Linear footages of pipe and conduit with fittings
Labor hours and crew installation rates

services.name: Preliminary & Conceptual Budgets
services.description: Early-stage cost modeling for owners, architects, and developers based on schematic drawings or square-foot benchmarks.

services.name: Value Engineering & Cost Optimization
services.description: Systematic review of design specs and materials to provide cost-effective alternatives and reduce overall budget while maintaining design intent.

services.name: CPM Construction Scheduling
services.description: Primavera P6 or Microsoft Project scheduling with critical path analysis, milestone schedules, and trade sequencing.
deliverables: Milestone tracking and critical path report

services.name: CAD Drafting & Plan Preparation
services.description: Construction drafting support including 2D CAD drafting, shop drawings, redline updates, and permit drawings.
deliverables: AutoCAD .dwg files and vector .pdf drawing packages

services.name: Stamping & Engineering Coordination
services.description: Coordination with licensed Professional Engineers (PE) and Structural Engineers (SE) for jurisdiction-specific plan stamping.
services.typical_turnaround: Dependent on jurisdiction and review scope
